question:
Sunil starts walking from Point R. He walks 28 m towards the west, turns right and walks for 20 m to reach point M. He then takes a left turn, walks for 30 m, takes a left turn and walks for 28 m to reach Point S. He finally takes a left turn and walks for 48 m to reach Point Z.

In which direction is Point Z with respect to Point R? (All turns are 90° turns only)
solution:
From the given information the direction of Sunil is as follows :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/89feb5bf8b46835ceebe5c721b513f3ee3901ca10437d261f729d75528c78095.png] 

∴ Here, **'Z' is in south-west direction with respect to 'R'.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"South-West".**
